content.text: The most recent championship meeting between them took place in the Super 8s in 2019, where Donegal emerged victorious with a score of 2-19 to 1-13. Given that a spot in the All-Ireland final is on the line, Sunday’s match is expected to be far more competitive.

As Tyrone and Kerry prepare to pen the newest installment of their fierce and historic rivalry in Saturday's All-Ireland SFC semi-final, let's revisit their inaugural championship clash during the 1986 All-Ireland final, where the Kingdom triumphed with a score of 2-15 to 1-10.
Kerry, who last won the title in 2022, will face the winners of Sunday's semi-final between Donegal and Meath (16:00 BST) in the showpiece game on 27 July.
